name: What are common signs that my sticking window needs professional repair?

mainEntity.name: What are common signs that my sticking window needs professional repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Beyond simply being difficult to open or close, signs that a sticking window needs professional attention include visible damage to the frame like rot or warping, broken or missing hardware components such as sash balances or cranks, persistent drafts indicating poor sealing, or if the window repeatedly gets stuck even after attempts at cleaning. If the window feels unstable or makes unusual noises, it's also a good indicator for a professional assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Signs include visible frame damage, broken hardware, persistent drafts, repeated sticking after cleaning, instability, or unusual noises. These indicate a need for professional repair.
